C0907.title: Female Streamers Buy Fake Underage IDs to Attract Top Spenders
C0907.summary: In March 2023, Yangpu police in Shanghai cracked a forged identity document case. Suspect Zhang bought forged ID cards online at low prices and resold them for profit. Buyers included social platform streamers Wang and Zhu, who ordered fake IDs with lower ages to attract high-spending viewers. Police verified seven illegal ID trading acts and Zhang sale of seven forged IDs; Zhang was criminally detained, and Wang and three others received administrative penalties.

references.title: Police Track Down Both Sellers and Buyers After Fake-ID Ads Were Posted on WeChat Moments
